Iris Holt: hi team! thrilled to join Redwood Inference as a solutions engineer. :wave: based in ATL (EST). i collect tiny plants and bonsai, and i code at night. first day remote, will be popping into core channels. quick q: where do we post our desk setup pics?
Juno: welcome Iris!! we usually drop those in #random or this thread if you want a slow drip. :seedling: also we do a welcome lunch in a couple weeks for new hires.
People Ops Bot: @Iris Holt please complete the New Hire Shipping form: https://redwood.example.com/ship-form to receive swag. reply here if you opt out. :package:
Iris Holt: form submitted. please send extra stickers for the bonsai, thx. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Sam: welcome! bonsai pics are mandatory. also, if you like tiny plants, you'll fit in.
Avery: hey Iris 1 welcome aboard. timezone-friendly coffee match? EST mornings are popular.
Iris Holt: mornings 9-11am EST work great. happy to be matched.
DevEx: heads up: onboarding checklist pinned in #new-hires. set up 2FA and join #eng and #support. ping if anything missing.
Iris Holt: joined channels, 2FA queued. thanks for the warm welcome everyone! excited to meet y'all.
Juno: epic. tagging you for the newbie lunch list. also FYI our office has a tiny zen corner dedicated to bonsai memes.
Sam: welcome again! must see bonsai and desk photos. :camera_flash:
